entry.title: Awesome Dataviz Updates on Oct 04, 2026
entry.content:
JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Apache ECharts (⭐67k) - Highly customizable and interactive charts ready for big datasets.
  • billboard.js (⭐6k) - Reusable D3.js-based chart library with SVG and Canvas rendering, maintained by NAVER.
  • C3.js (⭐9.3k) - D3-based reusable chart library.
  • Charts.css (⭐6.6k) - CSS framework that styles HTML tables as charts.
  • Frappe Charts (⭐15k) - Simple, responsive SVG charts with zero dependencies.
  • Frappe Gantt (⭐6.1k) - Simple, interactive SVG Gantt chart library.
  • G2 (⭐13k) - An interactive and responsive charting library based on the grammar of graphics, maintained by Alibaba.
  • Glyph (⭐3) - Deterministic chart library that renders the same JSON spec to identical SVG on every platform, with DuckDB inside and an MCP server for AI agents.
  • Observable Plot (⭐5.4k) - A JavaScript library for exploratory data visualization.
  • roughViz (⭐7.2k) - Sketchy, hand-drawn style charts for the browser, based on Rough.js.
  • TOAST UI Chart (⭐5.4k) - Complete library with support for legacy browsers.
  • Unovis (⭐2.9k) - Modular data visualization framework for React, Angular, Svelte, Vue and vanilla TypeScript, by F5.
  • uPlot (⭐11k) - Small, fast canvas-based charts for time series, lines, areas, OHLC and bars.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

  • 3d-force-graph (⭐6.4k) - 3D force-directed graph component using Three.js/WebGL.
  • dagre (⭐5.8k) - Directed graph layout library for JavaScript.
  • elkjs (⭐2.8k) - Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) graph layout algorithms for JavaScript.
  • JointJS (⭐5.4k) - SVG-based JavaScript diagramming library for interactive diagrams and graph editors.
  • Vizdom (⭐193) - A declarative graph layout and rendering engine for Javascript/Typescript powered by Rust/WebAssembly.
  • Vue Flow (⭐6.9k) - Flowchart and node-based graph component for Vue 3.
  • X6 (⭐6.7k) - Diagramming library for DAGs, ER diagrams, flowcharts and other graph editors, maintained by Alibaba.
  • xyflow (⭐39k) - React Flow and Svelte Flow: libraries for building node-based editors, flow charts and interactive diagrams.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • dxcharts-lite (⭐101) - Flexible financial charting library based on HTML5 canvas.
  • Lightweight Charts (⭐17k) - Performant HTML5 canvas financial charts, from TradingView.

JavaScript tools / Maps

  • CanvasGlobe (⭐0) - Interactive Canvas 2D globes and flat world maps for JavaScript and React.
  • Cesium (⭐16k) - WebGL 3D globes and maps.
  • globe.gl (⭐3.2k) - UI component for globe data visualization using Three.js/WebGL.
  • Globedots (⭐0) - Dot-matrix WebGL2 globe in 17 kB with markers, arcs, labels, heat maps, and a day-night line.
  • MapLibre GL JS (⭐12k) - WebGL-based interactive vector tile maps in the browser; community fork of Mapbox GL JS.
  • maptalks.js (⭐4.5k) - Pluggable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
  • OpenLayers (⭐13k) - Library for interactive web maps with support for many data sources, formats and projections.
  • Pharos AI - Open-source OSINT conflict-tracking dashboard with geospatial visualization using Deck.gl, MapLibre, and React. (Source Code (⭐182))
  • Potree (⭐5.6k) - WebGL point cloud viewer for large datasets such as LiDAR scans.
  • React Simple Maps (⭐3.4k) - Composable SVG map charts for React, based on d3-geo and TopoJSON.
  • react-map-gl (⭐8.5k) - React components for MapLibre GL JS and Mapbox GL JS, maintained by vis.gl.
  • VectorAtlas - Free, 80KB SVG world map with one path per country, id-keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, ready for choropleths.

JavaScript tools / d3

  • D3.js (⭐114k) - JavaScript library for producing dynamic, data-driven visualizations with SVG, Canvas and HTML.

JavaScript tools / React

  • echarts-for-react (⭐5k) - React wrapper for Apache ECharts.
  • Graphic Walker (⭐3.3k) - An embeddable React component that functions as an open source alternative to Tableau, which allows data scientists to analyze data and visualize patterns with simple drag-and-drop operations.
  • MUI X Charts (⭐5.9k) - React chart components from MUI; the community package is MIT-licensed.
  • react-chartjs-2 (⭐6.9k) - React components for Chart.js.
  • Semiotic (⭐2.7k) - React data visualization library for charts, network graphs and streaming data.
  • Tremor (⭐16k) - React components for building charts and dashboards, based on Recharts and Tailwind CSS.
  • visx (⭐21k) - Low-level visualization components that combine D3 with React, by Airbnb.

JavaScript tools / React Native

  • React Native Chart Kit (⭐3.1k) - Line, bar, pie, progress and contribution graph charts for React Native.
  • react-native-graph (⭐2.6k) - Animated, high-performance line graphs for React Native, built with Skia.
  • react-native-maps (⭐16k) - Map view component for iOS and Android in React Native.
  • Victory Native (⭐1.2k) - High-performance charting library for React Native, built on React Native Skia.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • blessed-contrib (⭐16k) - Terminal dashboards with charts, maps, gauges and tables, built with Node.js and ASCII/ANSI art.
  • gp-treemap (⭐10) - Open source HTML canvas treemap component supporting millions of nodes, and some functional resource usage tools, like disk and S3 usage visualization (GrandPerspective-style)
  • Layer Cake (⭐1.8k) - Graphics framework for building reusable charts with Svelte.
  • Mosaic (⭐1.4k) - Framework for linking databases such as DuckDB with interactive views to visualize large datasets.
  • ngx-charts (⭐4.4k) - Declarative charting framework for Angular, using D3 for math and Angular for rendering.
  • ODataMap (⭐10) - Interactive scientific research data map. Visualizes 250M+ papers across 7 knowledge continents using D3.js. Demo
  • Perspective (⭐11k) - Interactive analytics and visualization component for large and streaming datasets, built on WebAssembly.
  • vtk.js (⭐1.5k) - JavaScript implementation of the Visualization Toolkit (VTK) for scientific visualization on the web.
  • vue-chartjs (⭐5.7k) - Vue.js wrapper for Chart.js.
  • vue-echarts (⭐11k) - Vue.js component for Apache ECharts.

Android tools / Misc

  • HelloCharts (⭐7.6k) - Android chart library with line, column, pie, bubble and combo charts, plus zoom and scroll.
  • Vico (⭐3.2k) - Extensible chart library for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform.

C++ tools / Misc

  • F3D (⭐4.7k) - Cross-platform, fast, and minimalist 3D viewer with scientific visualization tools.
  • ImPlot (⭐6.2k) - Immediate-mode plotting library for Dear ImGui.
  • MapLibre Native (⭐2.3k) - Interactive vector tile map rendering for iOS, Android and other native platforms.
  • Mapnik (⭐4k) - Toolkit for rendering maps, widely used to render OpenStreetMap tiles.
  • Matplot++ (⭐4.9k) - C++ graphics library for data visualization with a MATLAB-like API.
  • ParaView (⭐1.7k) - Multi-platform data analysis and visualization application based on VTK.
  • PlotJuggler (⭐6.2k) - open-source Qt5 application to plot charts (based on Qwt).
  • Polyscope (⭐2.2k) - Viewer and user interface for 3D geometry processing.
  • QCustomPlot - Qt C++ widget for plotting and data visualization.
  • ROOT (⭐3.3k) - CERN framework for analyzing, storing and visualizing large scientific datasets.
  • TTK (⭐481) - Topological data analysis and visualization.
  • VisIt (⭐532) - Visualization and analysis tool for large mesh-based scientific data, developed at LLNL.
  • Visualization Toolkit (VTK) (⭐3.2k) - open-source library for 3d Graphics, image processing and visualization.

Dashboards and BI / Misc

  • Apache Superset (⭐75k) - Data exploration and visualization platform with a no-code chart builder, SQL IDE and dashboards.
  • DataLens (⭐1.7k) - Business intelligence and data visualization system, originally developed at Yandex.
  • Evidence (⭐7k) - Business intelligence as code: build reports and dashboards with SQL and Markdown.
  • Grafana (⭐77k) - Observability and data visualization platform for metrics, logs and traces from many data sources.
  • Kibana (⭐21k) - Visualization and dashboard UI for data stored in Elasticsearch.
  • Lightdash (⭐6.2k) - BI tool that turns dbt projects into metrics, charts and dashboards.
  • Metabase (⭐50k) - Business intelligence tool for querying data and building dashboards, with embedded analytics.
  • Observable Framework (⭐3.7k) - Static site generator for data apps, dashboards and reports using JavaScript, SQL and Markdown.
  • OpenSearch Dashboards (⭐2.1k) - Visualization and dashboard UI for OpenSearch; Apache-2.0 fork of Kibana 7.10.
  • Perses (⭐2.5k) - CNCF dashboard tool and open dashboard specification for observability data such as Prometheus metrics.
  • Redash (⭐29k) - Query data sources with SQL, then visualize the results and build dashboards.
  • Rill (⭐2.9k) - BI tool for fast, metrics-first dashboards powered by OLAP engines such as DuckDB and ClickHouse.

Flutter tools / Misc

  • fl_chart (⭐7.6k) - Customizable Flutter chart library with line, bar, pie, scatter and radar charts.
  • flutter_map (⭐3k) - Vendor-free, customizable interactive map package for Flutter.
  • Graphic (⭐1.8k) - Grammar of graphics data visualization and charting library for Flutter.

Golang tools / Misc

  • asciigraph (⭐3.1k) - Lightweight ASCII line graphs for command-line apps.
  • go-diagrams (⭐5.2k) - Diagram-as-code library for system architecture diagrams in Go, rendered with Graphviz.
  • go-echarts (⭐7.6k) - Simple yet powerful data visualizing library for Go.
  • termdash (⭐3k) - Terminal-based dashboard library with line charts, bar charts, gauges and donuts.
  • termui (⭐14k) - Terminal dashboard and widget library with charts, gauges, sparklines and more.

iOS tools / Misc

  • Charts (⭐28k) - iOS port of MPAndroidChart. You can create charts for both platforms with very similar code.
  • ChartView (⭐5.6k) - Line, bar and pie chart views built with SwiftUI.
  • Core Plot (⭐2.8k) - 2D plotting framework for macOS, iOS and tvOS.
  • SwiftCharts (⭐2.6k) - Customizable charts library for iOS.

Julia tools / Misc

  • Gadfly.jl (⭐1.9k) - Statistical graphics for Julia based on the grammar of graphics.
  • Makie (⭐2.8k) - Interactive, high-performance plotting ecosystem for Julia with OpenGL, WebGL and Cairo backends.
  • Plots.jl (⭐2k) - Plotting meta-package for Julia with a single API over multiple backends.
  • UnicodePlots.jl (⭐1.5k) - Unicode-based scientific plotting in the terminal for Julia.

JVM tools / Misc

  • JFreeChart (⭐1.4k) - 2D chart library for Java applications using Swing, JavaFX or server-side rendering.
  • Kandy (⭐746) - Kotlin plotting library with a typed DSL, developed by JetBrains.
  • Lets-Plot for Kotlin (⭐487) - Grammar of graphics plotting API for Kotlin, built on Lets-Plot.
  • XChart (⭐1.6k) - Lightweight Java library for plotting data.

Machine Learning tools / Misc

  • Aim (⭐6.3k) - Experiment tracker with a UI to explore and compare ML runs and metrics.
  • BertViz (⭐8.2k) - Visualize attention in Transformer language models such as BERT and GPT-2.
  • Comet (⭐176) - An MLOps platform for tracking, visualizing, and debugging your machine learning workflows from training straight through to production.
  • dtreeviz (⭐3.2k) - Decision tree visualization and model interpretation library for Python.
  • Embedding Atlas (⭐5k) - Interactive visualization of large embeddings with search, filtering and density views, by Apple.
  • FiftyOne (⭐11k) - Tool for visualizing, curating and evaluating computer vision datasets and models.
  • LIT (⭐3.7k) - Learning Interpretability Tool: interactive visual analysis of ML model behavior, by Google PAIR.
  • Netron (⭐34k) - Viewer for neural network, deep learning and machine learning models.
  • Opik (⭐22k) - Formerly CometLLM. Debug, evaluate, and monitor LLM applications with tracing and dashboards.
  • Phoenix (⭐12k) - ML observability in a notebook with UMAP visualizations
  • PlotNeuralNet (⭐25k) - LaTeX code for drawing neural network architecture diagrams.
  • TensorBoard (⭐7.2k) - TensorFlow's visualization toolkit for metrics, model graphs, embeddings and more.
  • Visdom (⭐10k) - Tool for real-time visualization and monitoring of live data such as ML experiments.
  • Yellowbrick (⭐4.4k) - Visual analysis and diagnostic tools for machine learning model selection with scikit-learn.

.NET tools / Misc

  • LiveCharts2 (⭐5.5k) - Animated, interactive charts, maps and gauges for .NET UI frameworks.
  • Mapsui (⭐1.6k) - .NET map component for MAUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, Blazor, WPF and WinUI.
  • Microcharts (⭐2.1k) - Simple cross-platform charts for .NET, drawn with SkiaSharp.
  • MSAGL (⭐1.5k) - Microsoft Automatic Graph Layout: tools for graph layout and viewing in .NET.
  • OxyPlot (⭐3.5k) - Cross-platform plotting library for .NET.
  • ScottPlot (⭐6.8k) - Interactive plotting library for .NET with WinForms, WPF, Avalonia, Blazor and other controls.

Python tools / Misc

  • bokeh - Interactive Web Plotting for Python.
  • bqplot (⭐3.7k) - Plotting library for IPython/Jupyter notebooks.
  • Cartopy (⭐1.6k) - Cartographic projections and geospatial data plotting with matplotlib.
  • Dash (⭐24k) - Framework for building data apps and dashboards in Python, built on Plotly.js and React.
  • Datashader (⭐3.6k) - Renders very large datasets into accurate images by rasterizing them.
  • folium (⭐7.4k) - Builds interactive Leaflet.js maps from Python data.
  • leafmap (⭐3.8k) - Interactive mapping and geospatial analysis in Jupyter with multiple mapping backends.
  • Lets-Plot (⭐1.8k) - Grammar of graphics plotting library for Python and Kotlin, by JetBrains.
  • mayavi - interactive scientific data visualization and 3D plotting in Python.
  • mplfinance (⭐4.4k) - Financial market data visualization (candlestick, OHLC, volume) using matplotlib.
  • napari (⭐2.8k) - Fast, interactive viewer for multi-dimensional images in Python.
  • Panel (⭐5.8k) - Data exploration and web app framework for Python that works with many plotting libraries.
  • Plotext (⭐2.2k) - Plots data directly in the terminal with a matplotlib-like syntax.
  • plotly - Interactive web based visualization built on top of plotly.js (⭐18k)
  • plotnine (⭐4.8k) - Grammar of graphics for Python, based on R's ggplot2.
  • pyecharts (⭐16k) - Python binding for Echarts library.
  • PyGWalker (⭐16k) - Turns dataframes into a drag-and-drop visual analysis UI in Jupyter, based on Graphic Walker.
  • Quibbler (⭐332) - Your data and anything you plot is effortlessly live and interactive.
  • Rerun (⭐12k) - An SDK for logging computer vision and robotics data paired with a visualizer for exploring that data over time.
  • SciencePlots (⭐9.3k) - Matplotlib styles for scientific figures and journal publications.
  • Shiny for Python (⭐1.8k) - Python version of the Shiny reactive framework for interactive data apps.
  • Streamlit (⭐46k) - Framework for turning Python scripts into interactive data apps.
  • syd (⭐30) - A package for making GUIs around matplotlib figures easy, fast, and streamlined.
  • Taipy (⭐19k) - Python framework for building data and AI web applications with interactive charts and dashboards.
  • uniplot (⭐461) - Lightweight plotting to the terminal. 4x resolution via Unicode.
  • vedo (⭐2.3k) - Library for scientific analysis and visualization of 3D objects based on VTK.
  • Voilà (⭐5.9k) - Turns Jupyter notebooks into standalone interactive web applications.
  • WordCloud (⭐11k) - Word cloud generator for Python.
  • ydata-profiling (⭐14k) - Generates statistical analytic reports with visualization for quick data analysis (formerly pandas-profiling).
  • yt (⭐559) - Toolkit for analysis and visualization of volumetric data.

R tools / Misc

  • ComplexHeatmap (⭐1.6k) - Highly customizable heatmaps for genomic and other matrix data (Bioconductor).
  • DiagrammeR (⭐1.7k) - Graph and network diagrams in R, rendered with Graphviz and mermaid.
  • esquisse (⭐1.9k) - Drag-and-drop interface for building ggplot2 charts in RStudio or Shiny.
  • gganimate (⭐2k) - Grammar of animated graphics that extends ggplot2.
  • ggraph (⭐1.1k) - Grammar of graphics for graphs and networks, extending ggplot2.
  • ggrepel (⭐1.3k) - Repels overlapping text labels away from each other in ggplot2 plots.
  • ggstatsplot (⭐2.2k) - ggplot2-based plots with statistical test details included in the graphic.
  • gt (⭐2.2k) - Builds publication-quality display tables in R.
  • Leaflet for R (⭐841) - R interface to the Leaflet JavaScript library for interactive maps.
  • patchwork (⭐2.6k) - Composes multiple ggplot2 plots into a single figure.
  • plotly (⭐2.7k) - Interactive charts (including adding interactivity to ggplot2 output), cartograms and simple network diagrams
  • rayshader (⭐2.2k) - 2D and 3D mapping and data visualization in R, including 3D renders of ggplot2 plots.

Ruby tools / Misc

  • Blazer (⭐4.8k) - Business intelligence tool for Rails apps: explore data with SQL and build charts and dashboards.
  • Gruff (⭐1.4k) - Graphing library for Ruby that renders charts as images using RMagick.
  • YouPlot (⭐4.9k) - Command-line tool that draws plots in the terminal from piped data.

Rust tools / Misc

  • Charming (⭐2.6k) - Chart rendering library for Rust powered by Apache ECharts.
  • malevich (⭐69) - Terminal plotting: line, scatter, bar, histogram, heatmap, box plot, violin and more, with automatic axes.
  • Plotly.rs (⭐1.5k) - Plotly.js-based interactive plotting library for Rust.
  • Plotters (⭐4.6k) - Drawing library for data plotting in Rust, with bitmap, SVG, WebAssembly and GUI backends.

Markup-based tools / Misc

  • D2 (⭐26k) - Declarative diagram scripting language that turns text into diagrams.
  • Diagrams (⭐43k) - Diagram as code in Python for prototyping cloud system architectures.
  • flowchart.js (⭐8.7k) - Draws SVG flowcharts from a textual description.
  • Kroki (⭐4.4k) - Unified API that renders diagrams from many text formats, including PlantUML, Mermaid, Graphviz and D2.
  • LikeC4 (⭐5.8k) - Architecture-as-code language and tools that generate live, interactive diagrams.
  • Markmap (⭐13k) - Builds interactive mind maps from Markdown.
  • Mermaid (⭐91k) - Generate diagrams and flowcharts from markdown-like text definitions, with a live editor.
  • Penrose (⭐8k) - Creates diagrams from mathematical notation in plain text, from Carnegie Mellon University.
  • PGFPlots (⭐257) - TeX package for drawing 2D and 3D plots directly in LaTeX documents.
  • PlantUML (⭐13k) - Generates UML, Gantt, mind map and other diagrams from plain text.
  • WaveDrom - Draws timing diagrams and waveforms from simple textual descriptions.

Other tools / Misc

  • csvtodashboard - Turn a CSV or Excel file into an auto-built dashboard in the browser - client-side, no upload.
  • Cytoscape (⭐731) - Desktop platform for network analysis and visualization, widely used in bioinformatics.
  • DAC (⭐776) - Dashboard-as-code tool that builds interactive dashboards from YAML and TSX definitions
  • Data Formulator (⭐18k) - AI-assisted tool for transforming data and creating visualizations, from Microsoft Research.
  • FlameGraph (⭐20k) - Stack trace visualizer that generates interactive SVG flame graphs from profiling data.
  • gnuplot - Command-line driven program for 2D and 3D plots, with many output formats.
  • Gource (⭐13k) - Animated visualization of software version control history.
  • ink-uplot (⭐1) - Render uPlot charts in the terminal (React Ink) with truecolor Unicode and kitty/sixel/iTerm2 graphics.
  • LabPlot (⭐486) - KDE application for interactive scientific plotting, data analysis and visualization.
  • Orange (⭐5.7k) - Visual programming tool for data mining, machine learning and interactive data visualization.
  • Plotivy - Scientific data visualization tool, with AI-generated reproducible Python code, and research-oriented design best practices built in.
  • QGIS (⭐14k) - Desktop geographic information system for viewing, editing, analyzing and mapping geospatial data.
  • RATH (⭐4.7k) - Automatic Exploratory Data Analysis & Data Visualization tool which is powered by an AI-assisted Augmented Analytics engine.
  • Resseract Lite (⭐7) - A Data Analytics and Visualization Tool with flexible architecture to visualize and analyse data
  • Sampler (⭐15k) - Terminal dashboard that runs shell commands and visualizes their output, configured with YAML.
  • SandDance (⭐7.1k) - Visual data exploration and presentation with animated unit visualizations, from Microsoft Research.
  • sankeydiagram.net - Web app for creating and sharing Sankey diagrams of flows and budgets without code.
  • Squey - Visualization software for exploring and understanding large amounts of tabular data (using parallel coordinates, timeseries and scatter plots).
  • VisiData (⭐9.3k) - Terminal spreadsheet multitool for exploring and arranging tabular data, with basic plotting.

Books / Misc

  • R in Action, Third Edition by Robert I. Kabacoff. A complete learning resource for R and tidyverse.
  • Everyday Data Visualization by Desireé Abbott. A field guide for design techniques that will improve the charts, reports, and data dashboards you build every day.

Websites / Misc

  • Global Data Tracker - Interactive country-statistics explorer with historical charts and globe views.
  • Plottie - Open-access library of scientific plots for inspiration and AI visualization tool.
  • The Planet Thinks - Real-time visualization of Wikipedia edits on a 3D globe
  • VivaMap - Interactive quality-of-life map of Swiss and Dutch municipalities, scored on an H3 hexagon grid.
  • Marble Taxonomy Explorer - Interactive knowledge graph visualization of 1,590 learning topics using Cytoscape.js with force-directed, concentric, and BFS layouts. Source (⭐9)
  • Use the format - [Name](https://github.com/owner/repo) - Short description. and link to the source repository when there is one.
  • The website is rebuilt from this file automatically; see site/ for how it works.
  • Hal9 is the corporate sponsor.

entry.title: Awesome Dataviz Updates on Dec 12, 2021
entry.content:
JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Chart.js - Charts with the canvas tag.
  • Chartist.js - Responsive charts with great browser compatibility.
  • Dygraphs - Interactive line charts library that works with huge datasets.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

  • Cola.js - A tool to create diagrams using constraint-based optimization techniques. Works with d3 and svg.js.
  • Cytoscape.js - JavaScript library for graph drawing maintained by Cytoscape core developers.
  • Sigma.js - JavaScript library dedicated to graph drawing.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • TechanJS - Stock and financial charts.

JavaScript tools / Maps

  • Deck.gl - WebGL framework for visual exploratory data analysis of large datasets.
  • Leaflet - JavaScript library for mobile-friendly interactive maps.

JavaScript tools / React

  • nivo (⭐14k) - Supercharged dataviz components for React with isomorphic ability, demo.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • Textures.js - A library to create SVG patterns.
  • Timeline.js - Create interactive timelines.
  • Vis.js - A dynamic visualization library including timeline, networks and graphs (2D and 3D).

Python tools / Misc

  • holoviews - Complex and declarative visualizations from annotated data.
  • matplotlib - 2D plotting library.
  • PyQtGraph - Interactive and realtime 2D/3D/Image plotting and science/engineering widgets.
  • toyplot - The kid-sized plotting toolkit for Python with grownup-sized goals.
  • VisPy - High-performance scientific visualization based on OpenGL.

R tools / Misc

  • ggvis - A data visualization package with a syntax similar to ggplot2 which allows you to create rich interactive graphics.
  • lattice - trellis graphics for R
  • rbokeh - R Interface to Bokeh.
  • shiny - Framework for creating interactive applications/visualisations

Other tools / Misc

  • Kepler.gl - Geospatial analysis tool for large-scale data sets.
  • RAW - Create web visualizations from CSV or Excel files.

Books / Misc

  • Interactive Data Visualization for the Web by Scott Murray. Available to read online. Focused on D3.
  • Data Visualisation: A Handbook for Data Driven Design by Andy Kirk

Catalogs / Misc

  • The Data Visualization Catalogue - A collection of data visualization methods, with pros and cons.
